name: Classic Margherita Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 250°C (482°F) with a baking stone if available.
Roll out dough to a 12-inch circle on a floured surface.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over dough, leaving a 1/2-inch border.
Scatter mozzarella cheese over sauce.
Bake on the stone for 10-12 minutes until crust is crisp and cheese melts.
Finish with basil leaves, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and optional parmesan.
Slice and serve immediately.
image_description: This image features a Classic Margherita Pizza with a thin, golden-brown crust topped with fresh tomato sauce, slices of mozzarella cheese, and basil leaves. The pizza is presented whole on a wooden cutting board, showing a rustic preparation style. The portion size suggests a single serving, ideal for individual enjoyment.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream or coconut cream
directions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, cumin, coriander, and a pinch of salt for at least 30 minutes.
In a large pan, heat oil and sauté onion until translucent.
Add garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add marinated chicken; cook until browned on all sides.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Reduce heat and add cream; simmer 5-10 minutes until sauce thickens.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: This image features a rich Chicken Tikka Masala, topped with creamy, red tomato-based sauce. The dish includes succulent pieces of grilled chicken, garnished with fresh cilantro. It is served in a wide, shallow bowl, with a side of basmati rice and naan bread. The presentation is vibrant and appetizing, suggesting a generous portion meant for sharing.

name: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Tofu
directions: Toss tofu with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Fry tofu until golden; remove and set aside.
Add garlic and vegetables; stir-fry 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return tofu to pan; add rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, and sesame oil.
Cook 1-2 minutes until coated; serve with steamed rice.
image_description: This image displays a vibrant vegetable stir-fry with tofu. Visible ingredients include bell peppers, broccoli, carrots, and green onions, all lightly stir-fried and seasoned. The dish is presented in a wide, shallow bowl, garnished with a sprinkle of sesame seeds and served as a single, generous portion.

name: Greek Giouvertsa Salad with Lemon-Oregano Dressing
directions: Toss romaine, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives, and feta in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper to make dressing.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Serve immediately.
image_description: This image showcases a vibrant Giouvertsa Salad featuring crisp romaine lettuce, juicy cherry tomatoes, creamy feta cheese, and tender cucumbers, all dressed with a lemon-oregano vinaigrette. The salad is neatly arranged in a shallow, white bowl, presenting a single, generous portion meant for individual serving.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
directions: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Heat olive oil in a pan; add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook until fragrant and lightly golden.
Toss pasta with garlic oil, adding reserve water as needed.
Season, mix in parsley, and serve with parmesan.
image_description: This image shows a generous serving of Spaghetti Aglio e Olio, featuring bright red chili flakes scattered on top. The dish appears to be presented in a shallow bowl, with the pasta's light golden hue indicating a simple yet flavorful preparation.

name: Distance-Glazed Salmon with Dill
directions: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix honey, soy sauce, mustard, and dill.
Season salmon with salt and pepper; brush with glaze.
Bake 10-12 minutes until flaky; drizzle remaining glaze over and serve.
image_description: This image showcases a perfectly cooked piece of distance-glazed salmon, featuring a golden-brown crust with visible flaky texture. The salmon is garnished with fresh dill sprigs, and the presentation is elegant with a minimalist plating style, emphasizing the dish's simplicity and freshness.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent.
Add crushed tomatoes and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth or leave chunky based on preference.
Stir in cream and basil; season to taste and serve.
image_description: This image shows a bowl of Tomato Basil Soup. The soup features ripe red tomatoes, fresh basil leaves, and a rich, red broth. It is presented in a simple, rustic bowl, with a garnish of a basil leaf on top. The portion appears to be a single serving.

name: Pad Thai
ingredients: 1 tablespoon palm sugar or brown sugar
directions: Prepare noodles according to package; drain and set aside.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, and sugar to make sauce.
Sauté garlic in oil; add shrimp or chicken and cook through.
Push meat aside, scramble eggs in the pan, then mix with noodles.
Add sauce and bean sprouts; toss quickly.
Garnish with peanuts, lime wedges, and chili flakes if desired.
image_description: This image showcases a vibrant plate of Pad Thai, featuring stir-fried rice noodles tossed with crispy egg, tofu, and a mix of green onions and bean sprouts. The dish is garnished with a sprinkle of crushed peanuts and a wedge of lime on the side, suggesting a fresh and colorful presentation. The portion is generously sized, indicating a single serving meant to satisfy.

name: Chickpea Falafel with Tahini
ingredients: Tahini sauce: 1/4 cup tahini, lemon juice, water
directions: Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, flour, and spices until coarse.
Form into small patties or balls.
Fry in hot oil until golden and crisp.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and water to desired consistency.
Serve falafel with tahini sauce.
image_description: This image showcases three golden-brown falafel patties drizzled with creamy tahini sauce. Plated on a white ceramic dish, they are garnished with fresh parsley and served with a side of crisp lettuce. The portion size is moderate, suitable for a single serving.

name: Beef Tacos with Salsa Verde
directions: Cook beef with taco seasoning until browned.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill tortillas with beef, lettuce, tomatoes, and cheese.
Top with salsa verde and sour cream if desired.
image_description: This image showcases a plate of Beef Tacos with Salsa Verde. The tacos are filled with seasoned ground beef, garnished with fresh cilantro, and topped with a generous spoonful of green salsa. The presentation is neat with a single portion served on a white plate.

name: Pan-Seared Ribeye Steak
directions: Season steaks with salt and pepper.
Sear in a hot pan with butter until desired doneness (about 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare).
Add garlic and thyme during the last minute, spooning butter over steaks.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: This image displays a perfectly pan-seared ribeye steak, showcasing a rich, caramelized crust and a juicy, pink interior. The steak is presented on a white plate, garnished with a sprig of fresh herbs, and accompanied by a small side of roasted vegetables.

name: Lentil Dal with Cumin and Turmeric
directions: Rinse lentils until water runs clear.
Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add cumin and turmeric, cook 1 minute.
Add lentils and water; simmer 20-25 minutes until soft.
Season and garnish with cilantro.
image_description: This image showcases a bowl of vibrant yellow lentil dal. It is garnished with a sprinkle of cumin and turmeric, highlighting its aromatic spices. The dal is served in a modest portion, presented in a simple white bowl with a rustic charm.

name: Miso-Glazed Cod with Sesame Rice
ingredients: Sesame seeds and green onions for garnish
directions: Whisk miso, mirin, soy sauce, and sugar to make glaze.
Brush cod with glaze and let sit 5 minutes.
Pan-sear or bake cod until flaky.
Fluff rice with sesame oil, top with cod, sesame seeds, and green onions.
image_description: This image showcases a plate of miso-glazed cod accompanied by sesame rice. The cod is seared to a golden brown, glazed with a rich, glossy miso sauce, and garnished with finely chopped green onions. The sesame rice is lightly toasted and sprinkled with sesame seeds, providing a nutty contrast. The dish is elegantly plated, with the fish centered and the rice artfully arranged around it, suggesting a single serving.

name: Caribbean Jerk Chicken
directions: Marinate chicken with jerk seasoning, lime juice, olive oil, and salt for 20 minutes.
Grill or bake until cooked through, about 20-25 minutes.
Rest briefly and serve with sides like rice and beans.
image_description: This image shows Caribbean Jerk Chicken, featuring golden-brown chicken pieces seasoned with a vibrant spice rub. The dish is presented on a white plate with a garnish of fresh cilantro and lime wedges on the side, suggesting a single serving.

name: Roasted Tomato and Basil Pasta
directions: Roast tomatoes and garlic with olive oil for 15-20 minutes.
Cook pasta until al dente, reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Toss pasta with roasted tomatoes, add water to loosen if needed.
Stir in torn basil and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: This image showcases a plate of Roasted Tomato and Basil Pasta. The dish features vibrant red roasted tomatoes, fresh basil leaves, and al dente pasta tossed together. The cooking style appears rustic and home-cooked, with a generous portion served on a white plate, neatly arranged for a simple yet appealing presentation.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
directions: Fry paneer lightly until golden; set aside.
Sauté onion with butter, add ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato puree and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in cream, garam masala, and paneer; simmer 5 minutes.
Season to taste and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: This image shows a rich and creamy Paneer Butter Masala dish served in a wide bowl. The dish features chunks of paneer (Indian cottage cheese) in a thick, orange-red tomato-based sauce, garnished with a dollop of cream and a sprinkle of fresh cilantro. The presentation is rustic and hearty, indicative of a home-cooked meal.

name: Falooda (Dessert Drink)
ingredients: Cherries or shredded coconut for garnish
directions: In tall glasses, layer milk, rose syrup, soaked vermicelli, and sabja.
Add ice and garnish with cherries or coconut.
Serve with a spoon and straw.
image_description: This image displays a vibrant glass of Falooda, a traditional dessert drink. Visible are sweet basil seeds, vermicelli noodles, and a thick, creamy milk base, all garnished with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. The presentation is stylish, with the drink served in a tall, clear glass. The portion size appears to be a generous single serving.

name: Shakshuka
directions: Sauté onion and pepper in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic, tomatoes, paprika, and cumin; simmer 10 minutes.
Make four wells in sauce and crack in eggs.
Cover and cook until eggs set; garnish with parsley.
image_description: This image showcases a classic Shakshuka with poached eggs nestled in a rich, tomato-based sauce. The dish is garnished with fresh parsley and a sprinkle of paprika, served in a shallow, rustic bowl. The portion appears generous, suitable for sharing.

name: Cuban Black Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup dried black beans (or 2 cans, drained)
directions: Soak beans if using dried (overnight recommended).
Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add beans, bay leaf, cumin, and water.
Simmer until beans are tender (about 45 minutes for dried).
Serve over rice.
image_description: This image showcases a plate of Cuban Black Beans and Rice, featuring rich, dark beans and fluffy white rice. The dish is garnished with a sprig of fresh cilantro, presented in a casual, everyday style, likely served in a standard bowl or plate.

name: Beef Bulgogi
ingredients: 500g sirloin or flank steak, thinly sliced
directions: Marinate beef with soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger for 15-20 minutes.
Stir-fry in a hot pan 2-3 minutes until cooked.
Garnish with green onion and sesame seeds; serve with rice.
image_description: The image showcases a plate of Beef Bulgogi, featuring slices of tender, marinated beef arranged in an appealing circular pattern. The beef is accompanied by a side of crisp, julienned vegetables and a small mound of steamed white rice, highlighting its vibrant color contrast.

name: Spanish Paella Valenciana
directions: Brown chicken and chorizo in olive oil; set aside.
Sauté onion and pepper; add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add rice, saffron, and broth; bring to boil.
Return meat, cover, simmer until rice is cooked and liquid absorbed.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: This image showcases a rustic bowl of Paella Valenciana, featuring a medley of saffron-infused rice, succulent pieces of chicken, tender rabbit, and vibrant green beans. The dish is presented in a wide, shallow bowl, highlighting the beautifully layered ingredients with a generous portion meant for sharing.

name: Tom Yum Goong
directions: Boil stock with lemongrass, lime leaves, and galangal for 10 minutes.
Add mushrooms and shrimp; cook until shrimp turn pink.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice; add chili paste if desired.
image_description: This image shows Tom Yum Goong, featuring a clear broth with visible shrimp, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, galangal, and mushrooms. The soup is presented in a deep white bowl, highlighting the vibrant and aromatic ingredients. The portion appears to be a single serving, elegantly plated to showcase the vibrant colors and textures of the dish.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
directions: Grill or pan-sear chicken; slice.
Toss lettuce with dressing and croutons.
Top with chicken slices and parmesan.
image_description: This image showcases a Chicken Caesar Salad featuring romaine lettuce leaves, slices of grilled chicken breast, and shavings of Parmesan cheese. The salad is drizzled with Caesar dressing and garnished with a few croutons, presented in a single serving on a white plate.

name: Moussaka
ingredients: Bechamel sauce: butter, flour, milk, nutmeg
directions: Roast eggplant slices until tender.
Cook lamb with onion and garlic; add tomatoes and season.
Layer eggplant and meat mixture in dish; top with bechamel.
Bake until golden and set.
image_description: This image displays a baked Moussaka, featuring layers of eggplant slices, a creamy white sauce, and ground meat. The dish is presented in a rectangular ceramic dish, garnished with a sprinkle of cheese on top, and served as a single portion.

name: Shoyu Ramen (Quick)
directions: Simmer broth with soy sauce and miso.
Cook noodles separately.
Assemble bowls with broth, noodles, meat, egg, and green onions.
image_description: This image shows a bowl of Shoyu Ramen, featuring glossy noodles with a golden-brown hue, topped with soft, slightly curled white slices of chashu pork. The bowl contains a clear, amber broth with visible bubbles and a hint of steam. The ramen is garnished with finely chopped green scallions and a slice of pickled ginger on the side. The portion size suggests a single serving, presented in a classic, straightforward style.

name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
directions: Cook pasta until al dente.
Sauté garlic in olive oil; add shrimp until pink.
Toss with pasta, lemon zest/juice, and parsley.
Season and serve.
image_description: This image shows Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta, featuring plump, juicy shrimp arranged over a bed of al dente linguine. The dish is garnished with fresh parsley and a light drizzle of olive oil, presented in a shallow white bowl with a rustic, casual style.

name: Ratatouille
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add vegetables; cook slowly with herbs until tender.
Season and serve warm or room temp.
image_description: This image shows a vibrant Ratatouille, featuring diced tomatoes, zucchini, bell peppers, onions, and herbs. The dish is presented in a rustic ceramic bowl, highlighting the medley of fresh, colorful vegetables with a drizzle of olive oil. The portion is a generous serving, meant to be shared.

name: Crispy Skin Salmon with Dill Yogurt
directions: Season salmon; sear skin-side down in butter until crisp.
Flip and cook to desired doneness.
Mix yogurt with dill and a squeeze of lemon; serve with salmon.
image_description: This image features a perfectly crispy skin salmon fillet, seasoned and seared to golden perfection. It is accompanied by a dollop of creamy dill yogurt, artfully placed on a white plate with garnishes of fresh dill sprigs. The dish is served as a single portion, highlighting the elegant simplicity of the presentation.

name: Thai Green Curry with Vegetables
ingredients: Assorted vegetables (bell peppers, zucchini, snow peas)
directions: Sauté curry paste briefly in oil.
Add coconut milk and simmer 5 minutes.
Add protein and vegetables; cook until tender.
Season with fish sauce and garnish with herbs; serve over rice.
image_description: This image showcases Thai Green Curry with Vegetables, featuring vibrant green curry paste, tender pieces of bell peppers, eggplant, and bamboo shoots. The dish is artfully plated in a shallow bowl, served in a single portion, highlighting the rich, aromatic curry and fresh, colorful vegetables.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
directions: Cook rice in water until tender.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt.
Pour coconut sauce over cooked rice and let absorb.
Serve with mango slices.
image_description: This image displays a bowl of Mango Sticky Rice, featuring steamed jasmine rice drizzled with rich coconut milk and garnished with fresh, ripe mango slices. The dish is served in a small, elegant bowl, highlighting a single, generous portion designed for individual enjoyment.

name: Herbed Quinoa Salad
ingredients: Lemon vinaigrette: lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper
directions: Cook quinoa in water until fluffy; cool.
Toss with vegetables, herbs, and vinaigrette.
Chill 10 minutes before serving if desired.
image_description: The image displays a vibrant herbed quinoa salad. Visible ingredients include light green quinoa, diced cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, and fresh parsley leaves. The salad is presented in a shallow, round white bowl, showcasing a mix of textures and colors. It appears to be a single serving, artfully arranged for a light meal or side dish.

name: Beef Shawarma Wrap
directions: Marinate beef with shawarma spices.
Cook beef in a hot pan until done.
Fill pitas with beef and vegetables; drizzle with sauce.
image_description: This image showcases a Beef Shawarma Wrap featuring layers of seasoned beef, vibrant vegetables, and a tangy sauce, all neatly wrapped in a warm, toasted pita bread. The wrap is artfully presented on a white plate, suggesting a single serving meant for individual enjoyment.

name: Pesto Chicken Bake
directions: Season chicken and place in baking dish.
Top each with pesto, mozzarella, and tomatoes.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 22-25 minutes until chicken is cooked.
image_description: This image showcases a Pesto Chicken Bake, featuring tender chicken pieces generously coated with vibrant green pesto. The dish is plated in a single serving, artistically arranged on a white plate with a light drizzle of olive oil.

name: Baked Eggplant Parmesan
directions: Dip eggplant slices in egg then breadcrumbs; bake until tender.
Layer with marinara and cheese; bake until golden.
image_description: This image showcases a single serving of Baked Eggplant Parmesan. It features a golden-brown, crispy eggplant slice topped with melted cheese, resting on a white plate. The dish is presented in an elegant, individual portion, with a side of marinara sauce and a sprinkle of fresh basil.

name: Moroccan Chickpea Stew
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add spices.
Add chickpeas and tomatoes; simmer 15-20 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve.
image_description: This image displays a bowl of Moroccan Chickpea Stew, featuring golden-brown chickpeas, tender pieces of carrot, and vibrant green parsley. The stew is presented in a rustic, shallow bowl, showcasing its rich, reddish-brown color and inviting aroma. The portion is a hearty serving, suggesting it is meant for a single, satisfying meal.

name: Crunchy Cabbage Slaw
directions: Mix dressing ingredients.
Toss with shredded cabbage and carrot.
Chill slightly before serving.
image_description: This image shows a vibrant Crunchy Cabbage Slaw, featuring finely shredded green and red cabbage. The slaw is garnished with a sprinkle of caraway seeds and served in a small, shallow white bowl. The presentation highlights the colorful contrast and the crisp texture of the vegetables.

name: Ceviche de Pescado
directions: Cure fish in lime juice for about 10-15 minutes until opaque.
Mix with onion, chili, and cilantro; season and serve.
image_description: This image showcases a vibrant plate of Ceviche de Pescado. It features diced raw white fish marinated in lime juice, accompanied by chopped red onions, cilantro, and diced tomatoes. The dish is artfully arranged on a white plate, highlighting the bright colors and freshness of the ingredients. The portion is medium-sized, suitable for a single serving.

name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow Gai)
directions: Sauté garlic and chili in oil until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook through.
Stir in soy and fish sauces; toss with basil until wilted.
Serve over steamed rice.
image_description: This image showcases a vibrant Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow Gai) dish. It features grilled chicken breast slices, fresh Thai basil leaves, and chilies, all harmoniously arranged on a white plate. The presentation is simple yet elegant, highlighting the dish's fresh and colorful ingredients. The portion appears to be a standard serving, suitable for a main course.

name: Caprese Salad
directions: Alternate tomato and mozzarella slices on a plate.
Top with basil; drizzle olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper.
image_description: The image displays a Caprese Salad with slices of ripe tomatoes, fresh basil leaves, and creamy mozzarella cheese. The ingredients are artfully arranged on a white plate, highlighting the vibrant colors and textures of the salad. The portion size is moderate, presented as a single serving.

name: Pumpkin Risotto
directions: Sauté onion in olive oil until translucent.
Add rice and toast 1-2 minutes.
Add warm broth gradually, stirring until absorbed.
Stir in pumpkin puree, butter, and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: The image showcases a creamy, golden Pumpkin Risotto garnished with a sprinkle of fresh sage leaves. It is served in a single, generous portion on a white plate, artfully plated with a slight mound in the center.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
directions: Melt butter; add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add shrimp; cook until pink.
Squeeze lemon juice; garnish with parsley and serve.
image_description: This image shows a plate of Garlic Butter Shrimp, featuring succulent shrimp sautéed in a rich, golden garlic butter sauce. The shrimp are arranged neatly on a white plate, garnished with a sprig of fresh parsley. The portion size is generous, suggesting a single serving for a light meal.

name: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus
directions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve with pita or veggies.
image_description: The image showcases a bowl of roasted red pepper hummus, featuring vibrant red and orange hues from the roasted peppers. It is garnished with a drizzle of olive oil and a sprinkle of paprika, presented in a rustic, shallow ceramic bowl, ideal for dipping with pita or vegetable sticks.

name: Garlic Naan
directions: Mix ingredients to form dough; knead until smooth.
Let rise 1 hour; divide and roll into rounds.
Cook on hot skillet 2-3 minutes per side.
Brush with garlic butter and serve.
image_description: This image shows a single piece of Garlic Naan, characterized by its golden, slightly charred crust. The naan is topped with visible garlic butter and a sprinkling of fresh herbs. It is served whole, resting on a white plate, with the side slightly folded for easy handling.

name: Butter Chicken
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in butter.
Add chicken and cook until sealed.
Stir in tomato sauce and garam masala; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in cream; season and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: This image shows a rich, creamy Butter Chicken served in a rustic bowl. The golden-brown dish features tender chunks of marinated chicken smothered in a thick, tomato-based sauce with hints of spices. The presentation is simple yet elegant, ideal for a cozy meal.

name: Coconut Curry Lentil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add curry powder.
Add lentils, coconut milk, and broth; simmer 25 minutes.
Season and serve hot.
image_description: This image shows a bowl of Coconut Curry Lentil Soup, featuring vibrant green lentils in a creamy, golden broth. The soup is garnished with fresh cilantro and served in a rustic white bowl, suggesting a single portion meant for individual enjoyment.

name: Gyro Wrap
ingredients: Gyro meat (lamb or chicken) or substitute with sliced chicken
directions: Cook gyro meat until browned.
Warm pita; fill with meat and vegetables.
Top with tzatziki.
image_description: This image showcases a Gyro Wrap filled with succulent slices of grilled meat, fresh tomatoes, crisp lettuce, and creamy tzatziki sauce, all wrapped in warm, golden pita bread. The wrap is neatly halved, revealing its layered ingredients, and is presented on a simple white plate, allowing the vibrant colors to stand out.

name: Pollo a la Brasa (Peruvian Roast Chicken)
directions: Marinate chicken with garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Roast at 200°C (400°F) for 40-45 minutes until cooked.
Serve with lime wedges.
image_description: This image showcases Pollo a la Brasa, a classic Peruvian roast chicken. The golden-brown chicken is presented whole, garnished with fresh parsley. It appears to be served on a white plate, suggesting a casual yet appetizing plating style. The portion looks generous, suitable for a main course.

name: Mango Salsa Chicken
directions: Season chicken and sear in a pan.
Top with mango salsa (mango, onion, cilantro, lime juice).
Bake 10 minutes to finish cooking.
image_description: This image showcases a plate of Mango Salsa Chicken, featuring grilled chicken slices topped with vibrant mango salsa. The dish is garnished with fresh cilantro and presented on a white plate with a clean, elegant style. The portion is moderate, suitable for a single serving.

name: Rice Paper Rolls with Peanut Dip
directions: Soak rice papers; fill with noodles, greens, and protein.
Roll tightly; serve with peanut dip.
image_description: This image shows an assortment of delicate rice paper rolls arranged on a white plate. Each roll is accompanied by a small bowl of creamy peanut dip. The rolls appear fresh and crisp, showcasing vibrant green vegetables, thinly sliced red radish, and bits of cooked shrimp. The presentation is clean and minimalist, highlighting the natural colors and textures of the ingredients. The portion size suggests a light appetizer or starter.

name: Beef Nachos
directions: Cook beef with seasoning.
Layer chips, beef, and cheese; bake until cheese melts.
Top with beans, salsa, sour cream, and jalapenos.
image_description: This image showcases a plate of Beef Nachos. The nachos feature a generous layer of crispy tortilla chips topped with shredded beef, red salsa, melted cheese, and diced tomatoes. The ingredients are artfully arranged in a shallow bowl, suggesting a casual and hearty serving style. The portion appears to be a single serving, ideal for a satisfying snack or appetizer.

name: Herbed Chicken Skewers
directions: Thread chicken onto skewers after marinating briefly.
Grill until cooked through, basting with oil and herbs.
Serve with lemon wedges.
image_description: This image showcases herb-marinated chicken skewers grilled to perfection. The skewers are presented on a white plate, arranged in a neat, visually appealing manner.

name: Coconut Shrimp Curry
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add curry powder.
Add coconut milk and vegetables; simmer 10 minutes.
Add shrimp; cook until pink and serve.
image_description: This image features a vibrant Coconut Shrimp Curry, showcasing succulent shrimp simmered in a rich, golden curry sauce. The dish is plated in a shallow bowl, garnished with fresh cilantro and a drizzle of coconut cream, presented in a rustic and inviting style.

name: Herbed Mushroom Risotto
directions: Sauté onion and mushrooms; add rice and toast.
Deglaze with wine; add broth gradually until creamy.
image_description: This image showcases a creamy Herbed Mushroom Risotto, featuring golden-brown sautéed mushrooms and a sprinkle of fresh herbs. The risotto is presented in a shallow bowl, garnished with a sprig of parsley, and served in a single generous portion.

name: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes
directions: Mix all ingredients into a smooth batter.
Cook on a hot skillet until bubbles form; flip and cook through.
image_description: This image features a stack of fluffy Lemon Ricotta Pancakes topped with a generous drizzle of maple syrup. The pancakes are presented on a white plate, with a small cluster of fresh blueberries and a sprig of mint for garnish. The portion size suggests a single serving.

name: Egg Fried Rice
directions: Scramble eggs in a wok; set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables, add rice, then eggs.
Season with soy sauce and scallions.
image_description: This image shows a plate of egg fried rice, featuring fluffy rice grains mixed with golden-brown egg pieces. The dish is garnished with green vegetables and is presented in a casual, single-serving style, suggesting a home-cooked meal.

name: Okonomiyaki (Japanese Pancake)
directions: Mix batter with cabbage.
Cook on a griddle; top with meat and flip.
Brush with sauce and drizzle with mayo.
image_description: This image displays a round Okonomiyaki (Japanese pancake) with visible ingredients such as cabbage, green onions, and a layer of batter. The pancake is sliced into wedges and presented on a white plate, showcasing a golden-brown exterior and a fluffy, layered interior. The portion size appears to be a single serving, artfully plated for a visually appealing presentation.

name: Herb-Ceta Pasta with Lemon
directions: Cook pasta; reserve some pasta water.
Toss with lemon zest, juice, herbs, and olive oil.
Add a splash of pasta water; finish with parmesan.
image_description: This image showcases Herb-Ceta Pasta with Lemon, featuring al dente pasta generously coated with a vibrant lemon sauce. The dish is garnished with finely chopped fresh herbs, adding a pop of color to the plate. The pasta is served in a single, large portion, elegantly presented in a white bowl.

name: Coconut Rice with Beans
directions: Simmer coconut milk with garlic powder; stir in beans and cilantro.
Serve over rice.
image_description: This image features a vibrant plate of coconut rice with beans. The rice is garnished with toasted coconut flakes and small green beans, arranged neatly on a white plate. The portion appears to be a single serving, served in a shallow bowl.

name: Baked Cod with Tomato and Olive
directions: Place cod in baking dish; top with tomatoes, olives, and garlic.
Drizzle with olive oil; bake at 200°C (400°F) for 12-15 minutes.
Garnish with parsley.
image_description: This image showcases a single portion of baked cod resting atop a vibrant bed of halved cherry tomatoes. The dish is garnished with a few black olives, and the presentation is simple yet elegant, highlighting the natural colors of the ingredients.

name: Seared Tuna Niçoise

directions: Cook filling with spinach and feta; stuff peppers.

name: Gado-Gado (Indonesian Peanut Salad)
ingredients: Peanut sauce: peanuts, palm sugar, tamarind, lime
directions: Arrange vegetables, eggs, and tofu on a plate.
Drizzle with warm peanut sauce and serve.
image_description: This image showcases a vibrant plate of Gado-Gado, featuring a mix of crisp boiled vegetables, tender tofu, and fluffy boiled egg slices, all drizzled with a rich peanut sauce. The salad is arranged neatly with each component placed artfully to highlight its fresh, colorful nature, served in a medium-sized portion on a white plate.

name: Kung Pao Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 1 tablespoon water
directions: In a small bowl, mix soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar to make the sauce.
Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry the chicken until cooked through; remove and set aside.
In the same wok, sauté garlic, ginger, and dried chilies until fragrant.
Return chicken to the wok, add the peanuts and the sauce mixture.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken.
Serve hot with steamed rice.
image_description: This image showcases Kung Pao Chicken, featuring a generous portion of tender chicken pieces, bright red bell peppers, and crispy peanuts. The dish is plated on a white plate with a rustic, yet elegant presentation, highlighting the vibrant colors and textures of the ingredients.

name: Mapo Tofu
directions: Brown the ground meat in a wok over medium-high heat.
Add the spicy bean paste and peppercorns, stirring until fragrant and the oil turns red.
Pour in the chicken broth and soy sauce; bring to a simmer.
Gently add the tofu cubes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry to thicken the sauce.
Garnish with green onions and serve.
image_description: This image displays a bowl of Mapo Tofu, featuring silky tofu cubes, minced meat, and a vibrant red sauce. The dish is garnished with green scallions and presented in a classic white bowl, suggesting a traditional Chinese style. The portion size appears to be a generous serving, likely meant for one person.

name: Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 300g flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain
directions: Toss beef slices with cornstarch and a splash of soy sauce; let sit for 10 minutes.
Blanch broccoli in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain.
Heat oil in a wok and sear beef at high heat until browned; remove.
Stir-fry ginger for 30 seconds, then add broccoli, oyster sauce, and soy sauce.
Return beef to the wok and toss everything together for 1 minute.
Serve immediately.
image_description: This image displays a plate of Beef and Broccoli. The dish features tender strips of beef stir-fried with crisp, dark green broccoli florets, garnished with a sprinkle of sesame seeds. The presentation is simple yet elegant, served on a white plate with a light background to highlight the vibrant colors. The portion size is moderate, suitable for a single serving.

name: General Tso's Chicken
ingredients: 500g chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
directions: Coat chicken pieces thoroughly in cornstarch.
Deep fry chicken in hot oil until crispy and golden; drain on paper towels.
In a separate pan, sauté ginger, garlic, and chilies.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar; simmer until the sugar dissolves.
Toss the crispy chicken into the sauce until fully coated.
Serve over white rice.
image_description: This image displays General Tso's Chicken featuring crispy fried chicken pieces tossed in a glossy, vibrant red sauce. The dish is garnished with fresh green onions and is presented in a shallow white bowl, served in a single portion.

name: Pork Potstickers (Dumplings)
directions: Mix pork, cabbage, soy sauce, sesame oil, and ginger in a bowl.
Place a teaspoon of filling in the center of a wrapper, moisten edges, and fold/pleat to seal.
Heat oil in a flat skillet and arrange dumplings in a single layer.
Fry for 2 minutes until bottoms are golden.
Pour in water and immediately cover with a lid to steam for 5-7 minutes.
Remove lid and cook until water evaporates and bottoms are crispy again.
image_description: The image displays a plate of golden brown Pork Potstickers, each with a crispy bottom and a filling of seasoned ground pork. They are arranged in a neat, appetizing stack, suggesting a freshly cooked style, likely pan-fried. The portion size appears to be a single serving, plated with a side of green garnish.

name: Hot and Sour Soup
directions: Bring broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add tofu, bamboo shoots, soy sauce, and white pepper.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and simmer until thickened.
Slowly drizzle in the beaten egg while stirring gently to create ribbons.
Stir in the rice vinegar at the very end to preserve the 'sour' punch.
Garnish with green onions.
image_description: The image showcases a bowl of Hot and Sour Soup, featuring a clear broth with visible strands of egg and chunks of tofu. The soup is garnished with fresh cilantro and sliced green onions, presenting a balanced color contrast. It is served in a medium-sized bowl, suggesting a single portion.

name: Chow Mein
directions: Boil noodles according to package instructions, drain, and set aside.
Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry cabbage and carrots for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles to the wok.
Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar, then pour over the noodles.
Toss at high heat for 2-3 minutes until noodles are slightly charred and well coated.
Serve hot.
image_description: This image showcases a plate of Chow Mein featuring stir-fried noodles, vibrant bell peppers, and slices of chicken, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds. The dish is artfully arranged on a white plate, with the noodles slightly curled and garnishes neatly placed for visual appeal. The portion size appears to be a standard serving, ideal for a single meal.

name: Wonton Soup
directions: Bring chicken broth and soy sauce to a boil in a pot.
Add the wontons and simmer for 5 minutes (or until they float).
Add bok choy and cook for 1 minute until wilted.
Turn off heat and stir in sesame oil.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with green onions.
image_description: This image displays a bowl of Wonton Soup with translucent wontons floating in a clear broth. The soup includes visible pieces of shrimp and pork within each wonton. The soup is served in a clear bowl, showcasing the light, brothy base with delicate, thin wontons. The portion appears to be a standard serving size for a single meal.

name: Honey Walnut Shrimp
directions: Dip shrimp in egg, then coat with cornstarch.
Fry shrimp in hot oil until golden and crispy; drain.
In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, honey, and condensed milk.
Toss the warm shrimp and candied walnuts into the sauce until evenly coated.
Serve immediately, usually garnished with steamed broccoli.
image_description: This image shows a plate of Honey Walnut Shrimp, featuring succulent shrimp glazed in a golden honey sauce and topped with crunchy walnuts. The shrimp are arranged in an appealing cluster on a white plate, suggesting a medium portion size, ideal for a main dish.
